      "observations": [
        "All 194 owned diff lines and both changed paths were read. The patch extracts #addChildren and makes cache creation private. Collapse splices the existing flat array; expansion takes head/tail slices, reserves descendant slots and assigns head.concat(tail), then fills children. Incremental updating does not preserve the same array identity on expansion.",
        "The actual rowCount getter counts undefined sparse child slots as one and counts expanded descendants even while the parent itself is closed. #addChildren uses array forEach, which skips holes, assigns parent/level/setSize/posInSet to present rows and returns slot count plus descendant offsets. A mechanical for...of replacement would visit undefined holes unless guarded; this is an exact receiver contract, not a global loop rule.",
        "Tree notification follows cache modification. Current TreeView.rowCountChanged reads the view's rowCount and emits rowcountchange; its toggle caller supplies a fallback only if the adapter did not notify. This ordering matters independently of a benchmark.",
        "Current Panorama thread/group hooks start with sparse children arrays, asynchronously fill them, clear the flat cache and invalidate rows only if still open. Both hook comments say called before open is set, but toggleOpenState sets row.open=true first and then invokes ensureChildren without awaiting it. This is a bounded comment/caller mismatch, not an observed async failure.",
        "The changed unit test removes two assertions requiring an invalidated cache. Remaining direct checks still inspect expansion/collapse row counts, returned rows, cached contents and hierarchy metadata; no new array-identity or performance assertion is added. Existing missing expected-behavior messages are linked to the already retained scoped assertion finding.",
        "No unit, UI, asynchronous fetch or benchmark ran. The mutation-invalidation lesson is reused with a precise clarification: collapse mutates an array, expansion replaces it, and asynchronous population still needs separate invalidation.",

It separates flat-list caching, cloned/recycled DOM rows and this later incremental expand/collapse patch. The author reports performance gains; no benchmark was measured here.",

Related Bug 2011355, regression 2019275, jobs and separate earlier review bodies remain bounded unread dependencies for this entry.",

Its summary says insert/remove instead of rebuilding; exact cache mechanics, sparse-array behavior and assertions come from source, not acceptance.",

The remaining direct unit assertions check row state and metadata; two obsolete invalid-cache assertions are removed. No stable-array-identity or performance assertion is added, and the existing missing-message finding is linked.",
        "The two current ensureChildren comments disagree with the actual caller's after-open order. This bounded source/documentation mismatch and the exact sparse forEach-versus-for...of contract are retained as focused public evidence. No asynchronous fetch, UI failure or speedup was reproduced."
